text:
mika: Quick heads-up 1: rolling a tight RBAC tweak for private-onprem keystore. Proposal: create NamespaceRole 'keystore-ops' with limited verbs (get,list,watch,create on secrets:public-cert, patch on leases) and bind it to SA 'keystore-connector'. full ClusterRole 'redwood-admins' not intended. Need eyes on egress + audit.
samir: Please paste the proposed role and the NetworkPolicy. small change, big surface.
mika: Role YAML inline:
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: keystore-ops
  namespace: redwood-keystore
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  resourceNames: ["public-cert"]
  verbs: ["get","list","watch"]
- apiGroups: ["coord.example.com"]
  resources: ["leases"]
  verbs: ["patch"]
```
NetworkPolicy (egress-only to HSM range):
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: keystore-egress-lockdown
  namespace: redwood-keystore
spec:
  podSelector: { matchLabels: { app: keystore-connector } }
  policyTypes: ["Egress"]
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock: { cidr: 10.12.11.0/24 }
    ports: [{ protocol: TCP, port: 443 }]
```
olga: Good. Couple flags: 1) audit log retention for onprem is 90d on node-level, but we maintain central index for 365d. For private customers we only forward metadata. Need to ensure full key-access traces include requestor identity, SA name, and pod UID.
trent: Also found an advisory: conn-proxy 0.9.1 has a high-severity CVE (CVE-2026-AB12) in its token re-use code. Our image for private bits is pinned to 0.9.0. We should upgrade to 0.9.2 before widening RBAC.
mika: Ugh. We planned to ship the role change today. Can we do a mitigated rollout? e.g., apply Role in canary namespace and enforce NetworkPolicy first.
sec-bot: Running targeted preflight: checks=[role-diff, networkpolicy-applyable, image-scan, audit-forward-test, token-projection]. ETA 30s.
sec-bot: Preflight results: role-diff OK (no clusterwide grants), networkpolicy OK (applies, no orphaning), image-scan FAIL (conn-proxy 0.9.0 flagged, recommended >=0.9.2), audit-forward-test PASS (last-forward 7s), token-projection WARNING (2 pods mount legacy automountServiceAccountToken=true).
samir: Legacy token mounts -> pod spec change to automountServiceAccountToken: false + projected token volume. Small bump but needs rolling update.
olga: For conn-proxy, we can patch daemonset to 0.9.2 and do node-by-node rolling update. Also add an ingress-only allowlist for management plane from the operator VPC so conn-proxy admin endpoints aren't exposed.
trent: We should also run an offline forensic checksum on persisted audit logs to ensure no tampering before we declare safe. Onprem stores logs in /var/log/redwood-audit, generate SHA256 manifests and ship to central attestation bucket.
mika: Plan: 1) Block RBAC change in prod until conn-proxy 0.9.2 rolled to pool-b and pool-c. 2) In canary: apply Role and NetworkPolicy but keep conn-proxy pinned until patched in canary. 3) Update the two pods with automount flag -> schedule low-traffic window. 4) After preflight green, run audit-injection test (create synthetic access event with SA identity and verify central index + attestation manifest).
samir: Tabletop: "key-priv-exfil-sim" on Thu 14:00 UTC? Ops, Sec, Product, and Customer Success invited.
olga: I'll prepare forensic script and attestation upload steps. Add runbook: if audit-forward backlog > 1000 then abort and roll back role change.
trent: Created ticket SEC-4891 with tasks: patch-conn-proxy, pod-projection, networkpolicy, preflight and tabletop. Attaching initial logs.
sec-bot: Ticket SEC-4891 created. Artifact links: /artifacts/sec-4891/preflight-3626009999.log, /artifacts/sec-4891/image-scan.json.
mika: Thanks team. Holding until SEC-4891 green. Will also add a post-change alert: if any secret.keystore access occurs from non-keystore namespace, auto-revert binding and page sec-oncall.
samir: also enable kube-apiserver audit-policy to include objectRef.requestUID and responseStatus for secret get/list events in that namespace.
olga: Agreed. I'll PR the audit-policy change and the forensic checks.
sec-bot: Reminder: make sure to tag the external customer config if they're on the private product; RBAC/egress changes may require their infra sign-off.
